basic_info.description: Situated in prestigious Jordan Park, this sun-filled top-floor residence combines timeless charm with modern upgrades in a boutique four-unit building. Classic SF details flow through this refined home while showcasing a thoughtful renovation and refinished Oak wood floors throughout. A generously-sized living room with beautiful, west-facing windows and crown molding transitions by way of french doors into a dramatic yet elegant formal dining room. Steps away, a luxuriously, newly remodeled kitchen featuring high-end SS appliances including gas range, sleek Quartz countertops & gold finishes. Two bedrooms including a spacious primary with custom built-in wall closet system for ample additional storage. The second bedroom has been upgraded with BredaBeds built-in Murphy bed, making transitions a breeze. A stylishly updated bathroom includes a Toto washlet along with beautiful, modern finishes. Additional features include a private oversized storage room, and the building offers a lovely, sunny shared backyard with BBQ patio plus outdoor dining area and video Doorbird intercom. Boasting a 95 Walk Score, easy access to Rossi Park, Golden Gate Park, and the Presidio. Close to Clement St. hotspots, and a few blocks to Laurel Village. Welcome home!
